form.modelPathHint: Full gjson path; use {provider_id} inside model as a placeholder for the current provider key
form.modelsContainerHint: Determines how models are written into the config file during managed sync. Array items each carry an id; object keys are model names. Choosing wrong will make the agent fail startup validation
form.commonHint: Field recommendations that are independent of the request protocol / SDK. Each row is one field: path / scope (provider|model) / recommended action (set / skip / delete) / recommended value / value shape (op / sep / allowed-values whitelist) / required / description. It uses the same "value + shape" rules as the rest of the page; fully blank rows are dropped on save. To edit the JSON directly, use "Switch to JSON edit mode" at the bottom left.

jsonMode.hint: The whole dialog as JSONC (name / paths / model info fields / common config / Endpoint rules protocols). The top and every block carry // comment lines so another Agent can make sense of it; comments do not affect saving. Validation runs before saving and before switching back to the table; invalid JSONC can be neither saved nor restored to a table.

modelInfoEditor.title: Common model info
modelInfoEditor.hint: How model info fields are written into each agent's config; "Sync model info" and managed generation write back using this. Each row is one field: path is the write location, op selects raw (as-is, default) / bool (non-empty → true, empty → false) / first (take the first element) / join (join array, sep optional, default comma); action can be set (default) / skip / delete field; allowed values is a whitelist (e.g. openclaw input only allows text/image/video/audio), comma-separated.

endpointRules.title: Endpoint rules (per SDK, one rule per card)
endpointRules.hint: One rule per endpoint: put endpoint keywords in the induction scope (e.g. completions / responses / chat/message, comma-separated); a rule applies when any keyword matches a substring of the endpoint, and order is priority. Private config uses a "value + shape" table: each row is a recommended field (path / scope / recommended action / recommended value / op / sep / allowed-values whitelist), scope (provider|model) / required / recommended (null = recommend not filling). For example, to pick which SDK NPM uses, fill key=npm, recommended value={"@ai-sdk/openai-compatible"} and tick required. To edit the JSON directly, use "Switch to JSON edit mode" at the bottom left of the dialog.
